tasks.title: Improve image upload handling
tasks.goal: Make file uploads safer and more scalable.
tasks.description: Enhance image pipeline now that uploads go through GCS.
improvements: add image compression using sharp before GCS upload
optionally create year/month folder structure in GCS bucket
tasks.notes: Extension and MIME type validation already in place via Multer fileFilter. Filename sanitization and sharp compression are the highest-value next steps.

tasks.title: User profile/settings page — extended fields
tasks.goal: Allow users to update username and email in addition to password.
tasks.description: The profile page currently supports password change and account deletion. Extend it to allow users to update username and email.
tasks.notes: Backend PATCH /users/me already supports username and email updates via allowedFields. Only frontend form work needed.

tasks.title: Admin panel
tasks.goal: Allow admin users to manage all users from within the app.
tasks.description: Add an Admin button to the navbar that is only visible when the logged-in user has admin: true. Links to an admin page with user management tools.
features: Change any user's username or email
Toggle admin role on/off for any user
Delete any user (and their associated places/images)
backendRequirements: GET /users — admin only, returns all users (already implemented)
PATCH /users/:userId — admin only, update username/email/admin role
DELETE /users/:userId — admin only, delete user and cascade delete their places and images (already implemented)
tasks.frontendNotes: Admin button in navbar conditionally rendered based on currentUser.admin === true. Separate AdminPage component with a users table.

tasks.title: Location support (Phase 2) — address autocomplete
tasks.goal: Let users search for a location by name using Nominatim.
tasks.description: Add address autocomplete via the free Nominatim API (OpenStreetMap) to the place form location name field. When a user selects a result, auto-populate lat/lng and set the map pin.
tasks.notes: Nominatim is free and requires no API key but has rate limiting — suitable for low-traffic dev/MVP use. Also consider improving Nominatim reverse geocode result quality in 'Find My Location' — currently only checks city/town/village fields.

tasks.title: Playwright end-to-end testing
tasks.goal: Cover critical user flows with automated tests.
tasks.description: Set up Playwright at the project root. Write e2e tests for auth, places, and notes flows. Currently in progress.

tasks.title: Remove or repurpose dead duplicate-key (409) handler in placeRouter.js
tasks.goal: Clean up now-unreachable error handling code.
tasks.description: The POST /places route has a MongoDB duplicate-key (code: 11000) → 409 handler that was added specifically to catch title collisions when title had a unique index. Since the unique constraint on title was removed (2026-07-01), this branch can no longer be triggered by title conflicts. Decide whether to delete it or leave it as a generic fallback for any future unique index.
tasks.notes: Not urgent — harmless dead code either way. Related to the title-uniqueness removal (see completedFeatures).

tasks.title: Transactional email flows
tasks.goal: Add email notifications and account recovery capability.
tasks.description: Integrate a transactional email service (e.g. SendGrid, Resend, or Nodemailer + SMTP) to support automated emails. Prototype locally with Nodemailer + Gmail SMTP before committing to a production service.

flows.email: Welcome / registration confirmation email sent to the user's email address
User submits their email address. If found, server sends an email containing their username. Always return 200 regardless of whether email exists (avoid user enumeration).
Password reset email containing a time-limited signed link (JWT or hashed token) that navigates the user to a ResetPasswordPage on the frontend

flows.page: ResetPasswordPage — accepts token from URL query param, verifies it server-side, allows user to set a new password

backendRequirements: POST /users/forgot-username — accepts email, sends username if found, always returns 200
POST /users/forgot-password — accepts email, sends reset link if email exists, always returns 200
POST /users/reset-password — accepts token + new password, verifies token, updates password
Token should be a short-lived signed JWT (15-30 min expiry) or a hashed random token stored in DB
securityNotes: Never confirm whether an email exists in forgot-password or forgot-username responses
Reset tokens must be single-use — invalidate after use
Reset token should expire after 15-30 minutes
